LTK - Creator Earnings ClippingLTK - Creator Earnings Clipping
Launch date: October 20, 2026
✓You do not need a dedicated page for this campaign. You can post on any page.
 WHAT TO DO
Post clips from the official LTK content folder.
Goal: show creators that people build real businesses on LTK.
Post on TikTok and Instagram Reels.
Content folder: https://f.io/JKAaVcKT 
Use only footage from this folder. Other footage will be rejected.
	

 TAGGING REQUIREMENT (REQUIRED)
Tag LTK at the end of your caption.
TikTok: @shop.ltk
Instagram: @ltk.hq
 CAPTION GUIDELINES (REQUIRED)
Mention LTK by name.
Write your own caption. Make it sound natural for your page, not like an ad.
Use the strongest fact from your clip.
EXAMPLES
People still call it "posting outfits online." 464 creators have become self-made millionaires through LTK.
LTK has created 464 self-made creator millionaires. All women.
Your GRWM is content. Your recommendations can be a business on LTK.
CAPTION RULES
Keep it genuine. Write what a real fan would say.
Keep it true. No made-up facts, stats, or dates.
Do not promise viewers they will earn money.
Write your own. Do not copy other clippers' captions.
 LOGO REQUIREMENT (REQUIRED)
Add the LTK logo to your clip as a watermark.
Use only the official logo file below.
Logo download: https://f.io/UE_fKM0F 
	

 ON-SCREEN TEXT (REQUIRED)
Add a text hook in the first 1 to 2 seconds.
Use the most surprising stat or quote from your clip.
Example hooks. You can also write your own.
464 creators have become self-made millionaires on LTK
LTK creates about one new creator millionaire every week
Brands invested nearly $450 million in LTK creators in 12 months
About 15% of creator earnings on LTK are passive
	

Same rule as captions. Keep it genuine and true.
 EDITING GUIDELINES
Background music is allowed, as long as the original audio is still clearly audible.
 REQUIREMENTS
POST SPECS
✓High-quality posts only. No blurry or low-effort content.
✓Video must be at least 10 seconds long
✓English content only
✓Post must stay live for 30 days minimum
PERFORMANCE
✓Minimum 0.50% engagement rate (1,000 views = at least 5 likes)
✓Likes must be visible. Hidden likes = automatic rejection.
✓Page audience should be mostly Tier 1-2 countries (30%+ Tier 3 may be removed)
✓By participating you agree to make your post FTC compliant
 NOT ALLOWED
CONTENT
✗Footage from outside the official content folder
✗Captions that do not mention and tag LTK
✗Clips without the LTK logo
✗Posting on any platform other than TikTok or Instagram
✗Low-quality or lazy uploads
✗NSFW, violent, or controversial content
✗Racist, homophobic, or sexual content = instant ban
✗Reposting another creator's video as your own
✗Exaggerated hooks, rage bait, or hate bait
✗False or made-up claims, stats, or dates
✗Mislabeling the content (a trailer is not "gameplay")
ENGAGEMENT FRAUD
✗Bait posting: unrelated viral content to farm views
✗Spam posting: the same video on multiple accounts
✗Story boosting: story views do not count
✗Paid promotion or ads of any kind = permanent ban
✗Posting the same video more than 5 times
POST VIOLATIONS
✗Removing the post before 30 days
✗Hidden likes
Questions? Message the Clipping Culture team, not LTK. We will help.
